news_items.headline: Zay Flowers not practicing Monday
news_items.body: Zay Flowers is not practicing on Monday for unclear reasons. Flowers walked onto the practice field in sneakers and a T-shirt on Monday. There should be an update on his status when available.

news_items.headline: Makai Lemon (hamstring) practicing in full on Monday
news_items.body: Makai Lemon (hamstring) is back to practicing fully for the first time in weeks. He returned to practice in a limited fashion last week, and is now practicing in full. This is huge for Lemon's development and integration into the offense. The more reps he gets, especially as a rookie, the better. He's looking like a potential draft steal if he can continue to stay healthy and improve his game.

news_items.headline: DeVonta Smith practicing fully on Monday
news_items.body: Devonta Smith (hamstring) is practicing fully on Monday for the first time in three weeks. He returned in a limited fashion recently, but he is back to fully participating. It's great news for Smith as he works his way back from a hamstring injury. This should be the all the confidence boost fantasy managers needed to continue targeting him highly in drafts.

news_items.headline: TreVeyon Henderson departs practice early
news_items.body: TreVeyon Henderson slipped during practice while making a cut and left practice early. Hopefully it's just a precaution and nothing serious, more along the vein of a stinger than anything major. Still, fantasy managers will need to wait until more news emerges to really get a grip on the details.

news_items.headline: Daniel Carlson signs with Saints
news_items.body: The Saints signed K Daniel Carlson. Carlson will compete with Tanner Brown and Charlie Smyth for the starting kicker job for New Orleans.

news_items.headline: Ryan Miller waived by Giants
news_items.body: The Giants waived WR Ryan Miller. Miller will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.

news_items.headline: Deshaun Watson named Browns starter for Week 1
news_items.body: Deshaun Watson has been named the Browns starting QB for Week 1 against Jacksonville. Watson was the favorite to win the job going in, and even though he had some hiccups on the way, namely preseason struggles and the fans booing him, he won out in the end. It's still likely that Shedeur Sanders will get a crack as the starter at some point this year, it's just a matter of when. As for the Browns pass catchers, they were priced assuming bad QB play, expect their price and fantasy ceiling to rema…

news_items.headline: Zamir White traded to Saints
news_items.body: Zamir White was traded to the New Orleans Saints on Sunday in exchange for Deion Jones. White is now heading to New Orleans after being picked up by the 49ers this offseason. The 26-year-old is likely being brought in as a depth piece behind Travis Etienne Jr. following the injury to Alvin Kamara, who is expected to be sidelined for a month with a sprained MCL.

news_items.headline: Deion Jones traded to 49ers
news_items.body: Deion Jones was traded to the San Francisco 49ers on Sunday in exchange for Zamir White. Jones is now on his way to the West Coast after signing with the Saints earlier in the month. The linebacker appeared in 17 games with Tampa Bay last season and will look to provide a veteran presence for the 49ers' linebacker room.

news_items.headline: Bud Clark (leg) carted off from Sunday's preseason game
news_items.body: Bud Clark was carted off from Sunday's preseason game with an apparent leg injury. Clark's lower right leg was put in an aircast before he was carted off, which is never a good sign. The 2026 second-round pick will likely be on the shelf to begin the season, but a timetable will likely become available at some point this week.

news_items.headline: Ashton Jeanty believed to have sprained ankle
news_items.body: Ashton Jeanty is believed to have suffered a sprained ankle at practice on Sunday. Jeanty was unable to put weight on his right leg after going down on Sunday, and it was originally believed to be a serious knee injury. However, the running back and the Raiders seemed to have dodged a bullet and avoided a long-term absence. However, the extent of the ankle sprain and timetable for his return remain unknown.

news_items.headline: Alex Wright (Achilles) placed on season-ending IR
news_items.body: Alex Wright (Achilles) has been placed on season-ending injured reserve with a torn Achilles. The 2025 breakout suffered the injury during practice on Thursday and will now miss the rest of the season. Wright was looking to build off of a career best 5.5 sack season, but will now have to turn his eyes onto 2027.

news_items.headline: George Kittle (Achilles) activated from PUP
news_items.body: George Kittle (Achilles) has been activated off of the 49ers PUP. A big step towards playing Week 1. Kittle was trending towards playing in Week 1, and this is a big step in that direction. He could be stepping into a big target share, especially with Mike Evans and De'Zhaun Stribling dealing with injuries of their own. Granted, the receivers injuries don't sound serious, but they're still noteworthy.

news_items.headline: Tyler Biadasz (knee) placed on season-ending injured reserve
news_items.body: Tyler Biadasz (knee) has been placed on season-ending injured reserve by the Los Angeles Chargers according to Ari Meirov. Biadasz suffered the knee injury earlier in the week during practice, leaving a gaping hole in a Chargers offensive line that hoped the offensive lineman would fortify the center position after signing with the organization during free agency. Backup Jake Slaughter will now ramp up to take on increased snaps at center for head coach Jim Harbaugh as the regular season approac…

news_items.headline: De'Zhaun Stribling (shoulder) day-to-day
news_items.body: De'Zhaun Stribling is day-to-day with a shoulder injury. Stribling has shown out in the first two preseason games for San Francisco. The rookie has already established himself into what is expected to be an immediate role for the 49ers wide receiver room. The 49ers will likely be cautious with him heading into the regular season.

news_items.headline: Michael Penix Jr. (knee) cleared for team drills
news_items.body: Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski told reporters that QB Michael Penix Jr. now has been cleared to return to 11-on-11 work. Penix has officially cleared all hurdles on his way back to full health. It remains unclear who will start in Week 1 between him and Tua Tagovailoa. This will remain a situation to monitor over the next couple of weeks.

news_items.headline: Rashawn Slater (knee) back practicing
news_items.body: Rashawn Slater was back at practice on Saturday. Slater had missed eight consecutive practices after suffering a flare-up in his knee. He still has a few weeks to get ready for Week 1.

news_items.headline: Jake Bobo (knee) placed on IR
news_items.body: The Seahawks placed WR Jake Bobo on injured reserve. Bobo suffered a serious knee injury during practice on Friday. His season is over. He signed a two-year, $5.5 million offer sheet with the Jaguars, as a restricted free agent that the Seahawks elected to match.

news_items.headline: Stefon Diggs expected to play against Lions
news_items.body: Stefon Diggs is set to make his Commanders debut in the preseason on Saturday. Diggs will see his first action as a member of the Commanders. It will be worth tuning in to see what his exact role looks like.

news_items.headline: Jayden Daniels expected to play against Lions
news_items.body: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels is set to start against the Lions on Saturday. Daniels had a very underwhelming sophomore campaign, largely due to injury. He and the starters will have an opportunity to build chemistry and momentum ahead of the regular season.

news_items.headline: Terry McLaurin expected to play against Lions
news_items.body: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin is set to start against the Lions on Saturday. McLaurin enters the fantasy football season as a top-50 selection. He and Jayden Daniels will have an opportunity to build momentum ahead of the regular season.

news_items.headline: Nick Chubb announces retirement
news_items.body: Nick Chubb has announced his retirement from the NFL via his personal Instagram. Chubb had a great NFL career as one of the most taleneted runners of the football of his generation. Coming out of Georgia with questions surrounding his health, he ended his time in Cleveland as one of the best running backs the franchise has seen before moving to Houston last year. He ends his eight year career with four Pro-Bowls, over 7,300 rushing yards at five yards per carry, and 54 rushing touchdowns.

news_items.headline: Tory Horton to 'be out for a period of time'
news_items.body: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said WR Tory Horton will be out "for a period of time." "He's still working through his stuff," Macdonald said. "He's going to be out for a period of time." Horton had his rookie season end early last year due to a shin injury. His status for Week 1 is uncertain.

news_items.headline: Zay Jones signing with Texans
news_items.body: Veteran WR Zay Jones is signing with the Houston Texans Jones provides the Texans with some insurance at the WR position after Jayden Higgins suffered a season-ending injury. At age 31, however, he remains a player with minimal fantasy value.

news_items.headline: Sterling Shepard signing with Texans
news_items.body: Veteran WR Sterling Shepard is signing with the Houston Texans Shepard signs with the Texans following Jayden Higgins' season-ending injury. Unfortunately, at age 33, he remains with little to no value in fantasy.

news_items.headline: Josh Reynolds linked to Texans
news_items.body: Free agent WR Josh Reynolds has been linked to the Texans. Houston is holding workouts after losing Jayden Higgins for the season. Reynolds previously worked out for the Saints.

news_items.headline: Jayden Higgins (knee) officially placed on season-ending IR
news_items.body: The Houston Texans officially placed Jayden Higgins on the season-ending injured reserve with a torn ACL. This was expected after Higgins was announced to have torn his ACL in a joint practice with the Raiders on Tuesday. Nico Collins is now likely the only Houston receiver on the fantasy radar, with Tank Dell still working back to full health and Xavier Hutchinson likely going undrafted in fantasy drafts. Dalton Schultz could see more opportunity with this injury.

news_items.headline: Tyreek Hill not expected to sign before Week 1
news_items.body: Tyreek Hill is not expected to sign with a team before the season begins, according to his agent Drew Rosenhaus. Hill has been on the long road to recovery after sustaining a major knee injury in Week 4 last season, and it looks like he will remain a free agent when the 2026 season begins. However, the 32-year-old could receive interest from contenders as the season goes on if he continues to progress in his rehab.

news_items.headline: Carnell Tate returns to practice Friday
news_items.body: Titans rookie WR Carnell Tate returned to practice on Friday. Tate missed practice time earlier this week due to "stiffness." The rookie could see some more reps in Sunday's preseason game against the Seahawks.

news_items.headline: Ennis Rakestraw Jr. suffers leg injury Thursday
news_items.body: Ennis Rakestraw Jr. left practice early on Thursday with a leg injury. It is unclear how serious the injury is. Rakestraw is day-to-day for now.

news_items.headline: Jimmy Rolder (leg) not ready to return to practice
news_items.body: Lions coach Dan Campbell says Jimmy Rolder isn't likely to return to practice by next week. Rolder went down with a leg injury earlier in August. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

news_items.headline: Roydell Williams released by Colts
news_items.body: The Colts released Roydell Williams. Indianapolis signed WR Keenan Allen as the corresponding move.

news_items.headline: Timothy McKay waived by Jaguars
news_items.body: The Jaguars waived OL Timothy McKay. McKay will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.

news_items.headline: Luke Grimm waived by Chargers
news_items.body: The Chargers waived WR Luke Grimm with an injury designation. Grimm will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp when he is cleared.

news_items.headline: Liam Clifford signs with Chargers
news_items.body: The Chargers signed WR Liam Clifford. Clifford will compete for a depth role in the Chargers wide receiver room.

news_items.headline: Jeadyn Lukus waived by Browns
news_items.body: The Browns waived CB Jeadyn Lukus. Lukus signed with Cleveland earlier in August. He'll figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.

news_items.headline: Jamil Muhammad signs with Browns
news_items.body: The Browns signed DL Jamil Muhammad. Muhammad spent time with both the Rams and Panthers last season. He'll compete for a depth role on the Browns defensive line.

news_items.headline: Chase Lucas released by Bucs
news_items.body: The Buccaneers released CB Chase Lucas with a four-week injury settlement. Lucas suffered a calf injury. He is expected to draw heavy interest when he is cleared.

news_items.headline: Matthew McDoom signs with Bengals
news_items.body: The Bengals signed CB Matthew McDoom. McDoom will compete for a depth role in the Bengals corner back room.

news_items.headline: Carson Beck (ribs) unlikely to play Saturday
news_items.body: Carson Beck (ribs) is unlikely to play in Saturday's preseason game against the Dallas Cowboys. Beck recently suffered an injury to his ribs. It's not considered a serious issue at this point, but it still looks like the team will have him sit out on Saturday as a precautionary measure. Gardner Minshew II is in line to be Arizona's starter against the Cowboys, assuming the 24-year old is officially ruled out ahead of game time.

news_items.headline: Jacoby Brissett won't play Saturday
news_items.body: Jacoby Brissett won't play in Saturday's preseason game against the Dallas Cowboys. The veteran quarterback will not suit up on Saturday. He took part in the team's first preseason game, but they apparently don't feel that he needs more reps and will let him sit out of their next game. Gardner Minshew II is expected to be the starter with Carson Beck (ribs) unlikely to play as well.

news_items.headline: Joey Porter Jr. drawing trade interest
news_items.body: Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr. is reportedly drawing interest on the trade market. Porter is currently on the NFL's PUP list and is reportedly seeking a contract extension. He could be on the move with the regular season approaching.

news_items.headline: Deebo Samuel Sr. starting against Chargers
news_items.body: 49ers WR Deebo Samuel Sr. will play against the Chargers in the preseason Thursday night's contest could offer a closer look at the type of role Samuel will have in the 49ers' offense this season.

news_items.headline: Fernando Mendoza to play roughly first half Thursday
news_items.body: Fernando Mendoza is expected to play roughly the first half in Thursday's preseason game against the Texans. Mendoza will get extended run on the field in his second preseason game. Aidan O'Connell will take the field in the second half.

news_items.headline: Danny Pinter (knee) to miss extended period of time
news_items.body: Danny Pinter is expected to miss an extended period of time after suffering a knee injury in Wednesday's practice. Pinter had been viewed as the likely leading candidate to start at center for the Ravens this season. That will not be the case, however, at least for a long while. Pinter tore a patellar tendon during Wednesday's practice session and could possibly miss the entire season.

news_items.headline: Pollard rushed twice for 12 yards and caught his only target for 33 yards in Sunday's 19-16 preseason win over the Seahawks.
news_items.body: All of Pollard's touches came within Tennessee's first five offensive plays of the game as he helped set up a field goal on the opening drive. Tyjae Spears played the next two drives with the starters, neither of which led to any points. Pollard sits atop Tennessee's running back depth chart after producing at least 1,288 yards from scrimmage in each of the last four regular seasons, half of which have come with the Titans.

news_items.headline: McPherson connected on field-goal attempts of 25 and 58 yards while also knocking home all three PATs in the Bengals' 27-9 preseason win over the Bears on Saturday.
news_items.body: McPherson put the Bengals on the board with 4:40 remaining in the opening period via his 25-yarder before pushing through his long-distance boot with 14:11 remaining in the contest to close out the scoring for either squad. McPherson, who's now 5-for-5 on field goals and 4-for-4 on PATs through two preseason games, is set to serve as Cincinnati's placekicker for the sixth straight season. The 2021 fifth-round pick is coming off a 2025 campaign where he posted a career-best 89.3 percent success r…

news_items.headline: Gainwell rushed once for no gain in the Buccaneers' 16-15 preseason win over the Chiefs on Saturday.
news_items.body: Both Gainwell and Bucky Irving logged their touches for the night on the opening possession. Gainwell wasn't targeted Saturday during his brief time in the game, but the veteran pass-catching back is ticketed to play a major role in that capacity come the regular season, albeit while likely taking only a modest amount of rushing touches from Bucky Irving and Sean Tucker. Gainwell will likely next see the field in a Week 1 road matchup against the Bengals on Sunday, Sept. 13.

news_items.headline: Franklin played 16 offensive snaps in Friday night's preseason game against the Packers, but he did not appear in the box score.
news_items.body: Franklin had a short night, so there's not much to glean from the lack of any target any targets for the wide receiver, who's in the mix, along with Marvin Mims (undisclosed) and Pat Bryant, for slotting behind Courtland Sutton and Jaylen Waddle. With the offseason addition of Waddle, Franklin is set to see a regression in target share, so he will need to earn every snap. The speedy Oregon product provides a nice deep threat to complement Waddle and Sutton, but it remains to be seen how much vol…

news_items.headline: Hunter did not play in the Jaguars' 34-17 preseason loss to the Panthers on Friday.
news_items.body: Hunter was joined by wide receivers Brian Thomas, Jakobi Meyers (hand) and Parker Washington on the sidelines for Friday's exhibition contest, which meant rookie sixth-rounders Josh Cameron and C.J. Williams were listed as the Jaguars' starting wideouts. Hunter has been listed as a backup WR and starting cornerback on the initial preseason depth chart, but he may not see much playing time on offense if both Cameron and Williams continue to impress the coaching staff in training camp and games. T…

news_items.headline: Judkins (undisclosed) is not expected to play in Saturday's preseason game against the Bills, Kelsey Russo of the Browns' official site reports.
news_items.body: Judkins missed consecutive training camp practices earlier this week while recovering from an undisclosed issue. It looks like he'll observe Saturday's exhibition game in street clothes, and it's unclear whether he'll suit up for the Browns' preseason finale against the Patriots on Thursday. Judkins' absence means Dylan Sampson will lead the Browns' backfield against the Bills, with Raheim Sanders, Ahmani Marshall and Davon Booth also in the mix for reps.

news_items.headline: Diggs is expected to make his preseason debut Saturday against Detroit, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
news_items.body: Diggs, Terry McLaurin and Jayden Daniels are all lined up to play Saturday after all three sat out of the Commanders' preseason opener against the Dolphins on Friday, Aug. 14. Diggs joined the Commanders in early August on a one-year, $12 million contract after playing for the Patriots in 2025. He's slated to serve as the team's WR2 behind McLaurin, with Luke McCaffrey, Treylon Burks and rookie third-rounder Antonio Williams all competing for the No. 3 role.

news_items.headline: Smith completed all seven of his pass attempts for 65 yards and a touchdown in Friday's 17-0 preseason win over the Steelers.
news_items.body: After sitting out the preseason opener due to a sore ankle, Smith saw the first game action of his second stint with the Jets. He played only the opening drive but was sharp during his brief time in the game, completing all seven of his passes to six different targets, including a 13-yard touchdown pass to Jelani Woods. Smith looks like he's in midseason form already, so it remains to be seen if the veteran QB will get any action in next Friday's preseason finale against the Giants.

news_items.headline: Judkins (undisclosed) didn't practice Thursday, but coach Todd Monken said afterward that the running back is tending to "a little something nagging, nothing big," Kelsey Russo of the Browns' official site reports.
news_items.body: Judkins has missed back-to-back sessions due to an unspecified injury, but considering Monken's comment, the Browns nonetheless are taking a cautious approach with the second-year pro. As a rookie second-round pick in 2025, Judkins tallied 230 carries for 827 yards and seven touchdowns while hauling in 26 of 36 targets for 171 yards in 14 regular-season games before suffering a dislocated right ankle and broken right fibula Week 16 that required surgery. He was taking 11-on-11 drills as of mid-M…

news_items.headline: Coach Mike LaFleur said Thursday that Brissett won't suit up for Saturday's preseason game against the Cowboys, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.
news_items.body: After a crisp preseason Week 1 in which he competed all five of his passes for 44 yards and one touchdown last Thursday at Las Vegas, Brissett will take a seat for the Cardinals' second exhibition, ceding the start to backup QB Gardner Minshew. Meanwhile, Carson Beck "most likely" won't be healthy enough to play through his rib injury, meaning Minshew and Kedon Slovis will handle signal-caller duties Saturday. After inking a reworked contract with Arizona in late July, Brissett again will lead t…

news_items.headline: Judkins (undisclosed) wasn't spotted at practice Thursday, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.
news_items.body: Judkins has been absent for back-to-back practices due to an unspecified issue that coach Todd Monken describes as a "nagging injury" per Scott Petrak of the Elyria Chronicle-Telegram. His status for Saturday's preseason tilt against the Bills has yet to be determined at this point. Judkins is locked in as Cleveland's top backfield option on early downs, though fellow second-year pro Dylan Sampson figures to get some opportunities in passing situations.

news_items.headline: Smith is scheduled to start Friday's preseason game against the Steelers, Connor Hughes of SNYtv reports.
news_items.body: Smith sat out the Jets' preseason opener due to a sore ankle, paving the way for rookie fourth-round pick Cade Klubnik to get the start. The veteran starter has since recovered and is set for the first game action of his second stint with the Jets. Smith sits safely atop the team's QB depth chart, while Klubnik looks like the favorite to secure the backup role over Bailey Zappe and Brady Cook.

news_items.headline: Judkins wasn't present at practice Wednesday due to an undisclosed minor injury, Mary Kay Cabot of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.
news_items.body: Judkins' absence may have stemmed from Tuesday's session, when he was front and center to some unnecessary hits, per Cabot. The Browns are hosting a joint practice with the Bills on Thursday before taking on Buffalo in preseason action Saturday, but it's unclear if Judkins will suit up for either of those. Dylan Sampson would stand to benefit with more work for as long as Judkins is sidelined.

news_items.headline: Pollard (undisclosed) returned to practice Wednesday, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.
news_items.body: Pollard missed Monday's practice after taking four carries for 22 yards and a TD in last Thursday's preseason opener against San Francisco. A quick return to the practice field suggests he'll be fine for Week 1, regardless of participation (or lack thereof) in the upcoming exhibition against Seattle on Sunday. Pollard was in for nine of Cam Ward's 22 snaps last week, with Tyjae Spears playing the other 13 snaps and taking five touches for 39 yards.

news_items.headline: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield said Tuesday that he's been "completely overwhelmed with the amount of talent" that Gainwell has, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.
news_items.body: Dramatic language and all, Gainwell apparently has a very important fan on his new team. While Bucky Irving remains the presumed lead runner, Gainwell should get a lot of the work on passing downs while also maintaining a small role in "pony" packages with two halfbacks on the field. New playcaller Zac Robinson used those double-RB looks on a league-high 95 plays (9.1 percent of total snaps) with the division-rival Falcons last year.

news_items.body: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. -- For the first time in training camp, the Jacksonville Jaguars limited Travis Hunter to one side of the ball in 11-on-11 work. Hunter played exclusively at cornerback Monday, getting on the field for 20 of the 24 snaps. Coach Liam Coen said the move was done to allow Hunter to focus more on playing without missing any mental reps when switching to offense. news_items.headline: Smith (ankle) was a full participant in Monday's training camp practice, Rich Cimini of ESPN.com reports.
news_items.body: Smith was spotted wearing a sleeve on his lower leg and was limping slightly at times during Monday's practice. Still, it was a positive sign from the veteran quarterback, who did not play in the Jets' preseason opener against the Buccaneers this past Friday due to left ankle soreness. It remains to be seen whether Smith and the other starters will play in the Jets' next preseason game, which takes place this Friday on the road against the Steelers.

news_items.headline: Pollard (undisclosed) wasn't spotted at practice Monday, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.
news_items.body: The same applies to fellow RBs Nicholas Singleton (undisclosed) and Kalel Mullings (hip), a context that also applied to Saturday's session, per Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com. For now, consider Pollard day-to-day as this Sunday's preseason contest against the Seahawks approaches. When available, Pollard is on track to continue to lead a Titans backfield that also includes Tyjae Spears, who is a candidate to see his share of touches in a complementary role.

news_items.headline: Smith (ankle) was on the field for Monday's practice, Rich Cimini of ESPN.com reports.
news_items.body: Per Cimini, Smith -- who didn't play in this past Friday's preseason game against the Buccaneers -- sported a sleeve on his lower left leg as he participated in Monday's walkthrough. It remains to be seen if the QB will be limited at practice in the coming days, but either way, Smith's next chance to see game action arrives this Friday against the Steelers.

news_items.headline: Johnson is listed as the starting tight end on the Saints' unofficial depth chart.
news_items.body: Johnson is coming off a breakout season in which he easily set career bests with 77 receptions and 889 yards, so it's little surprise that he remains the top tight end for the Saints. Now trailing him on the depth chart are offseason acquisition Noah Fant and rookie third-rounder Oscar Delp.

news_items.headline: Andrews was rested for Baltimore's 24-7 preseason win over the Eagles on Saturday.
news_items.body: Andrews and other key starters didn't suit up for the preseason opener. The 30-year-old tight end averaged a career-low 24.8 receiving yards per game during the 2025 regular season, but the Ravens didn't bring in any established pass catchers at the position to replace the departed Isaiah Likely, so Andrews has an opportunity to bounce back under a new coaching staff.

news_items.headline: Mason carried the ball three times for 17 yards in Saturday's 13-10 preseason win over the Giants.
news_items.body: The Vikings' starters on offense played just one possession, with both Mason and Aaron Jones getting snaps on a drive that ended with a 35-yard Will Reichard field goal. Mason was productive in his first season with Minnesota in 2025, rushing for 758 yards and six TDs on 159 carries in 16 regular-season games, and he seems set to work in a timeshare with Jones once again. The 31-year-old Jones still offers more big-play potential and utility as a receiver, but Mason should see the majority of the high-value touches near the goal line.

news_items.headline: Judkins carried the ball four times for nine yards in Saturday's 34-10 preseason loss to the Bears.
news_items.body: The second-year back got the start for the Browns but played only the first quarter before calling it a day. Judkins is the clear top dog in the backfield, and after gaining 998 scrimmage yards on 256 touches over 14 regular-season games as a rookie, the 2025 second-round pick is expected to take on a larger workload in 2026 under new head coach Todd Monken.

news_items.headline: Cook carried the ball five times for 21 yards in Saturday's 29-14 preseason win over the Panthers.
news_items.body: The reigning NFL rushing champ played the entire first quarter in the Bills' preseason opener, and Cook's longest gain was a 13-yard scamper that helped set up a Keon Coleman touchdown. Josh Allen remains the focal point of the offense, but Cook proved last season that he can rack up elite production as well, and the fifth-year RB could see more receiving work in 2026 as new offensive coordinator Pete Carmichael adds some wrinkles to Joe Brady's scheme.

news_items.headline: Fantasy Football 'Do Draft' list: Derrick Henry, Patrick Mahomes among undervalued players to pick
news_items.body: Buffalo Bills QB Josh Allen led his position with 364.62 fantasy points last season, and for six consecutive years, he has finished among the game's top two scorers at quarterback. However, quarterback is a deep position in 2026. One can make the case that nearly half the NFL teams have a QB worthy of starting for your fantasy team this season. Allen is awesome, but even last season he outscored vastly underrated Detroit Lions QB Jared Goff -- barely a top-10 performer at the position -- by only…

news_items.headline: Gainwell did not play in the Buccaneers' 24-16 preseason win over the Jets on Friday.
news_items.body: Both Gainwell and Bucky Irving, the Bucs' top running backs on the depth chart, observed Friday's game in street clothes while Josh Williams, Sean Tucker and Kadarius Calloway all saw action. Gainwell is coming off a breakout 2025 season with the Steelers, when he accumulated 1,023 yards from scrimmage on 187 touches across 17 regular-season games. He caught 73 passes (on 85 targets) last year with Pittsburgh, and he figures to see a sizable role in Tampa Bay's passing game for the upcoming season.

news_items.headline: Franklin caught one of two targets for 23 yards in Friday's 27-7 preseason win over the Falcons.
news_items.body: Franklin's lone reception came on the final play of the first quarter on a pass from Jarrett Stidham, who started at QB while Bo Nix rested. Franklin is competing for the third spot on the wide-receiver depth chart with 2025 third-round pick Pat Bryant and 2023 second-round pick Marvin Mims (undisclosed). Jaylen Waddle (leg) and Courtland Sutton are locked in as starters. Franklin had 709 receiving yards in the 2025 regular season, which was second most on the team behind Sutton's 1,017.

news_items.headline: Coach Aaron Glenn said after Friday's 24-16 preseason loss to the Buccaneers that Smith sat out the contest due to a sore ankle and is day-to-day, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.
news_items.body: Per Glenn, Smith picked up the injury during the Jets' joint practice with Tampa Bay on Wednesday. Considering Smith is deemed day-to-day, the Jets likely will exercise caution with him until he's back to 100 percent. In any case, his next opportunity for exhibition action is next Friday at Pittsburgh.

news_items.headline: Smith won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Buccaneers due to a sore foot, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
news_items.body: On Tuesday, coach Aaron Glenn told Al Iannazzone of Newsday that Smith and the rest of the Jets' starters would log some snaps Friday. While an injury to Smith has quelled those plans, the team isn't concerned about it, and he'd play through it if it was the regular season. Instead, New York will take a cautious approach with its starting quarterback, meaning his next chance for exhibition action is next Friday at Pittsburgh.

news_items.headline: Diggs isn't in line to play in Friday's preseason contest versus the Dolphins.
news_items.body: After the Patriots released Diggs in March, he finally found in a landing spot in the early stages of training camp, inking a one-year, $12 million contract to join the Commanders. While he has a week of practice under his belt with his new squad, he'll have to wait until at least Saturday, Aug. 22 at Detroit to get some in-game preseason reps with new QB Jayden Daniels and top WR Terry McLaurin. In 17 regular-season games for New England last season, Diggs put together an 85-1,013-4 line on 102 targets.

news_items.headline: Bowers started Thursday's preseason opener against Arizona and came out of the game after one snap.
news_items.body: The Raiders' other starters, including QB Kirk Cousins and RB Ashton Jeanty, continued to play throughout the opening drive. Not that this needed reinforcement, but the early exit is yet another sign of Bowers' massive importance to the Las Vegas offense. We may not see him again until Week 1 against Miami.

news_items.headline: Brissett completed all five of his passes for 44 yards and one touchdown during Thursday's 27-14 preseason win in Las Vegas.
news_items.body: In his first game action since agreeing to a reworked contract in late July, Brissett connected with WR Michael Wilson (twice for 23 yards), first-round rookie RB Jeremiyah Love (once for two yards), WR Kendrick Bourne (one time for 12 yards) and WR Marvin Harrison (a seven-yard TD). Meanwhile, standout TE Trey McBride logged just one play before hitting the sidelines. This was one exhibition contest with Brissett working with the first-team offense, but the offensive scheme under new coach Mike LaFleur appears to be running on all cylinders roughly one month before the regular season kicks off.

news_items.headline: Pollard rushed four times for 22 yards and a touchdown and wasn't targeted in the Titans' 19-13 preseason win over the 49ers on Thursday.
news_items.body: The veteran running back took the field with the rest of the Titans' starters on Tennessee's opening possession and wasted no time making an impact, quickly bursting up the middle for a 12-yard run on his team's first play from scrimmage. Pollard eventually capped the drive off with a five-yard touchdown run, finishing his abbreviated night in impressive fashion. Pollard is looking to maintain a firm hold on the No. 1 running back role over Tyjae Spears in what is expected to be an improved Tennessee offense, and Thursday's showing certainly got him off to a strong start in that regard.

news_items.headline: Wilson brought in both targets for 23 yards in the Cardinals' 27-14 preseason win over the Raiders on Thursday.
news_items.body: The Cardinals' starting offense took the field on the opening possession, and Wilson was on the receiving end of two of Jacoby Brissett's first three completions. The fourth-year wideout is coming off having posted a career-best 78-1,006-7 line on 126 targets over 17 regular-season games in 2025, but if Marvin Harrison is able to enjoy better healthy this coming season, Wilson could be headed for at least a slight statistical downturn in his No. 2 receiver role.

news_items.headline: London outlined that he tries to model his game after big-bodied wideouts like Mike Evans and former NFL stars Calvin Johnson, Dez Bryant and Andre Johnson, Robert Mays of The Athletic reports.
news_items.body: London saw a dip in production in 2025, but that was mostly due to a PCL sprain in his left knee that sidelined him for four contests late in the season. The wide receiver still caught 68 of 112 targets for 919 yards and seven scores over 12 regular-season contest, and the 76.6 yards per game were a new career-high for the 25-year-old. London understands that part of what makes him special is his 6-foot-4, 215-plus pound frame, and he'll look to continue to use it to his advantage in Year 5 with Atlanta. The wide receiver will once again face uncertainty at quarterback in 2026, as the team signed veteran Tua Tagovailoa (back) in the offseason to compete with Michael Penix (knee) for the starting job. Regardless of who is under center, London has elevated to being one of the top WRs in the league, and he figures to have another strong campaign this year.

news_items.headline: Pearsall announced Thursday in a post on his personal Instagram account that he underwent season-ending surgery to repair the PCL in his right knee, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.
news_items.body: The procedure typically carries a wide-ranging recovery timeline of 6-to-12 months, so while Pearsall will be ruled out for the season, it's not clear if he'll be available for the start of the 49ers' offseason program next spring or the start of training camp next summer. The wideout will wind up having played in just 20 of a possible 51 regular-season contests and one of two playoff games through his first three NFL campaigns, missing time as a rookie while recovering from a gunshot wound to the chest before being hampered by the PCL injury off and on in 2025. He'll turn 27 in September and will be entering the final season of his rookie contract in 2027.

news_items.headline: Pollard found paydirt at the Titans' joint practice with the 49ers on Tuesday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official website reports.
news_items.body: Pollard was able to reel in a touchdown through the air from Cam Ward during the team's red-zone period against San Francisco. The running back is set to face some added competition in the backfield this season after Tennessee selected Nicholas Singleton in the fifth round of this year's draft, while Tyjae Spears (undisclosed) is looking to put together his first healthy campaign since his rookie year in 2023. Pollard has been a bit of an iron man in his NFL career, missing just a handful of regular-season contests over the last five years, but the 29-year-old has seen his receiving production drop in each of the last three campaigns, and he could find himself on the sidelines more often in passing situations this season.

news_items.headline: Hunter is listed as a starting cornerback and second-string wide receiver on Jacksonville's initial preseason depth chart, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.
news_items.body: Michael DiRocco of ESPN.com reports that Hunter has played 96 snaps on defense and 61 on offense in 11-on-11s during the open portions of practice. The team hasn't been shy about the expectation that Hunter will take on a far larger defensive workload this season, but there's still rampant debate in fantasy circles about his usage on offense. His role on that side of the ball may depend in part on the health of Jacksonville's other wide receivers, namely Parker Washington, Brian Thomas and Jakobi Meyers.

news_items.headline: Henderson left Monday's practice with a right lower leg issue, Mike Kadlick of Sports Illustrated reports.
news_items.body: More updates will be available after practice regarding the extent of Henderson's injury. As long as the issue doesn't linger, Henderson is on track to combine with Rhamondre Stevenson in a New England backfield that should provide enough touches for both players to merit fantasy lineup consideration this coming season.

news_items.headline: Arroyo caught two of four targets for 50 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-16 preseason loss to the Titans.
news_items.body: Arroyo capped Seattle's opening drive with a 36-yard touchdown reception from Drew Lock. After producing only 179 receiving yards in his rookie regular season, Arroyo is trying to earn a larger role in his second NFL campaign. The 2025 second-round pick is set to open his sophomore season as the team's No. 2 TE behind AJ Barner.

news_items.headline: The Commanders released Ford (hamstring) on an injury settlement Sunday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
news_items.body: Washington previously placed Ford on injured reserve Tuesday due to an undisclosed issue, which John Keim of ESPN.com relays was a hamstring injury. The running back would have had to miss the entire season had he remained on injured reserve, but after reaching an injury settlement with Washington, he's now free to sign with a team once he's fully healthy. Ford spent the 2025 campaign with the Browns, appearing in 13 games and carrying 24 times for 73 yards (3.0 average) to go with 26 catches fo…

news_items.headline: Stribling (shoulder) returned to practice Sunday, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.
news_items.body: Stribling -- who was sporting a no-contact jersey during the session -- had been considered day-to-day with a shoulder injury after playing in San Francisco's 41-17 preseason win over the Chargers last Thursday. The second-round rookie has stood out with 11 catches on 13 targets for 109 yards across two exhibition games, and he should stand to make an immediate impact in the 49ers' banged-up receiving corps. Stribling's final chance to play this preseason will come Thursday versus the Raiders.

news_items.headline: Williams brought in two of six targets for 74 yards and a touchdown in the Patriots' 24-21 preseason win over the Eagles on Saturday.
news_items.body: Williams started the game while working with Tommy DeVito as his quarterback, but the duo failed to connect on the first two passes that went the fleet-footed wideout's way on the opening possession. They would eventually make up for it in the latter portion of the second quarter, when Williams hauled in a long pass down the right sideline and took it an additional 35 yards for a 69-yard touchdown. Williams' elite speed is unquestioned, but whether he can develop down-to-down consistency and tun…

news_items.headline: Allen secured three of five targets for seven yards in the Chiefs' 16-15 preseason loss to the Buccaneers on Saturday.
news_items.body: The 2026 fifth-round pick has shown up on film in the first two preseason games, as he now has five receptions on 10 targets over that span. Allen has netted only 27 receiving yards in the process, but he's worked exclusively with backup quarterbacks such as Justin Fields and Garrett Nussmeier. Allen saw action into the second half Saturday and may well take the field again for the preseason finale at home against the Seahawks on Friday night.

news_items.headline: Irving rushed three times for 14 yards in the Buccaneers' 16-15 preseason win over the Chiefs on Saturday.
news_items.body: Irving was one of the healthy Buccaneers offensive starters to suit up Saturday, and offensive coordinator Zac Robinson appeared intent on making sure the third-year back got his work in during his brief time in the game. Irving handled the ball in each of Tampa Bay's first three plays from scrimmage, with 12 of his 14 rushing yards coming on his first pair of touches. Following an injury-plagued 2025 season that saw him miss seven regular-season games, Irving is healthy ahead of the 2026 campai…

news_items.headline: Stribling is considered day-to-day due to a shoulder injury, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
news_items.body: Stribling may have picked up the injury during the 49ers' 41-17 preseason win over the Chargers on Thursday, when he caught four passes on five targets for 46 yards. He's seen plenty of action over the Niners' first two exhibition games, so San Francisco could take the cautious route with the rookie second-rounder and hold him out of this Thursday's preseason finale against Las Vegas.

news_items.headline: Penix (knee) has been cleared to participate in 11-on-11 drills, Marc Raimondi of ESPN.com reports.
news_items.body: It's a positive step in Penix's recovery from ACL surgery that he underwent in November. He's been limited to 7-on-7 drills for most of training camp, but the expectation is that he'll upgrade to full team drills Monday. Depending on how his knee reacts to additional work, Penix could play in the Falcons' preseason finale against the Dolphins on Friday.

news_items.headline: Shakir (undisclosed) won't play in Saturday's preseason game against Cleveland, Jay Skurski of The Buffalo News reports.
news_items.body: Shakir will join DJ Moore, Keon Coleman (foot/toe), Joshua Palmer and Skyler Bell (lower body) on the sidelines for Saturday's exhibition contest. Shakir is currently working through an unspecified injury, and while it doesn't appear to be a severe issue, it could prevent him from playing in the Bills' preseason finale against the Steelers on Thursday.

news_items.headline: Harris (undisclosed) will participate in Saturday's training camp practice, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.
news_items.body: Harris was held out of Thursday's preseason game against the 49ers due to an unspecified injury. It doesn't appear to be a severe issue, as he'll be back on the field for Saturday's practice, putting him on track to play in the Chargers' preseason finale against the Rams on Thursday. Harris is slated to serve as the team's WR3 behind Ladd McConkey and Quentin Johnston (lower body).

news_items.headline: Vidal turned four carries into six yards while catching both targets for 10 yards during the Chargers' 41-17 preseason loss to the 49ers on Thursday. He also returned one kickoff for 27 yards.
news_items.body: Vidal was the third running back with a touch behind Omarion Hampton and Keaton Mitchell, and Vidal's 19 snaps on offense were most among Chargers running backs. Vidal's production Thursday was not as good as his performance in the Chargers' preseason opener against the Texans, and it looks like Mitchell is in the lead for the RB2 job behind Hampton. The Chargers wrap up their preseason this Thursday against the Rams.

news_items.headline: Harris (undisclosed) didn't play in Thursday's preseason game against San Francisco, but coach Jim Harbaugh said afterward that the wideout should practice this weekend, Kris Rhim of ESPN.com reports.
news_items.body: It sounds like Harris is dealing with a minor injury. Quentin Johnston (lower body) also missed Thursday's exhibition, leaving rookie Brenen Thompson to fill in as a starter opposite Ladd McConkey. Come Week 1, it'll likely be McConkey, Johnston and Harris as the top three.

news_items.headline: Collins didn't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Raiders.
news_items.body: QB C.J. Stroud got the start, but Collins, David Montgomery and a few other key veteran were held out. With fellow wideout Jayden Higgins suffering an ACL tear this summer, Collins may see a dominant portion of Houston's downfield passes and red-zone targets. That might've been the case anyway, but target competition looks much weaker with the Texans potentially using a committee to replace their No. 2 receiver. Collins should be busy Week 1 against the Bills.

news_items.headline: Benson (knee) has not been present for any portion of the Cardinals' previous two full-squad practices this week, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.
news_items.body: After stretching with the team ahead of Monday's walkthrough practice, Benson hasn't since been seen by the media. He's been dealing with the knee injury all summer after missing the final 14 weeks of the 2025 campaign with an injury to the same knee. Unable to practice much or play so far this summer, Benson could be on the outside looking in for a roster spot, considering he doesn't play special teams.

news_items.headline: Penix said that he's meeting with his doctor Thursday to see where his left knee stands, William McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.
news_items.body: So far in training camp, Penix has been capped to 7-on-7 drills as he works his way back from the torn ACL he suffered in his left knee Week 11 of last season. He noted that he's hoping to gain clearance, likely for 11-on-11 work, during Thursday's check-up, but he's unsure that'll occur. In any case, Penix continues to make progress in his recovery, but his limitations in practice seemingly has him behind Tua Tagovailoa in the competition to be the Falcons' starting QB to begin the campaign.

He seems unlikely to suit up for Saturday's preseason game against the Browns, though no official declaration has come on that front. DJ Moore (lower body), Keon Coleman (foot) and Skyler Bell (lower body) are also dealing with injuries in Buffalo's banged-up wide receiver room.

news_items.headline: Giddens (hamstring) participated in Wednesday's practice, Nathan Brown of The Indianapolis Star reports.
news_items.body: Giddens was seeing some work with the first-team offense early in camp, but he's been battling a hamstring injury for a couple weeks now, and it's unclear how active he was in Wednesday's session despite being back in full pads and a helmet. Sixth-round rookie Seth McGowan has been a strong performer in practice this summer and is pushing Giddens in a big way for the RB2 job behind Jonathan Taylor. Giddens needs to get in some action over the final two preseason games.

news_items.headline: Kraft (knee) has been impressive in 11-on-11 drills since the Packers cleared him Sunday to take part in them at practice, Bill Huber of SI.com reports
news_items.body: Since that point, Kraft has been making plays against the Packers defense, recording four catches Sunday and five more Tuesday. One of those grabs occurred on a deep ball down the right side from QB Jordan Love, who arced a pass over CB Keisean Nixon that Kraft hauled in with one hand and then sprinted for a would-be touchdown. news_items.headline: Rodriguez has drawn positive reviews for his power-running style during training camp, John Shipley of SI.com reports.
news_items.body: Signed to a two-year, $10 million deal in March, Rodriguez made a full recovery from offseason foot surgery in advance of training camp and has been listed as co-starter with Bhayshul Tuten on the Jaguars' unofficial depth chart. With both Rodriguez and Tuten sitting out Jacksonville's first two preseason contests, it's been difficult to gauge how the snaps might be divvied up between the two once the regular season gets underway. While Rodriguez has lived up to his billing in camp as a bruising…

news_items.headline: Judkins (undisclosed) returned to practice Monday, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.
news_items.body: Judkins missed the final two practices of last week before sitting out Saturday's preseason loss to the Bills due to what coach Todd Monken described as "a little something nagging, nothing big," per Kelsey Russo of the Browns' official site. Even though he's mixing back into drills, Judkins may be eased in with Week 1 still roughly three weeks on the horizon.

news_items.headline: Both Tua Tagovailoa and Penix (knee) will take reps with the first-team offense Monday, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.
news_items.body: Monday's session will mark Penix's first work in full-team drills this summer, a significant milestone for the QB as he works his way back from the torn ACL he suffered in his left knee Week 11 of last season. At this stage, it's unclear if Penix will play in Friday's preseason finale against the Dolphins, but the 2024 first-rounder's ability to commence working in full drills gives him an opportunity to make some strides in the team's QB competition ahead of Week 1.

news_items.headline: Kayshon Boutte traded to Texans
news_items.body: The Patriots are sending WR Kayshon Boutte to the Texans in exchange for safety Jaylen Reed and a 2028 seventh-round pick. Boutte has had his name in trade rumors for most of the offseason following the Patriots offseason additions of AJ Brown and Romeo Doubs. Boutte will get a fresh start in a wide open wide receiver room with Houston. He should compete for a role as a field stretcher for the Texans.

news_items.headline: Hubbard (hamstring) remains on track for Week 1, according to Steve Reed of the Associated Press.
news_items.body: It was reported earlier in August that Hubbard was on track to suit up for Carolina's season opener, and per head coach Dave Canales he remains on track to do so. Should Hubbard suit up for Week 1 as anticipated, he and Jonathon Brooks will work in a committee, per Joe Person of The Athletic.

news_items.headline: Watson brought in two of three targets for 19 yards in the Packers' 33-13 preseason win over the Broncos on Friday.
news_items.body: Watson was involved right from the start of Friday's game, drawing a target on the first play from scrimmage that went incomplete and then recording a 14-yard grab on the second. The veteran receiver's other reception was a five-yard catch in the red zone later in the opening drive, and the oft-injured Watson likely will next take the field in a Week 1 road matchup against the Vikings on Sunday, Sept. 13.

news_items.headline: Waddle brought in his only target for 35 yards in the Broncos' 33-13 preseason loss to the Packers on Friday.
news_items.body: Making his team debut, Waddle made very good use of his one opportunity during his brief time in the game Friday. The speedy offseason addition got loose down the seam on a third-and-5 play and gained an additional 10 yards after the catch to put Denver deep into Green Bay territory. Waddle looked completely unencumbered by the muscle tightness in his leg that had plagued him earlier in the week, and Friday's cameo may represent the extent of the 2021 first-round pick's game action until a Week…

news_items.headline: Waddle is in uniform for Friday's preseason game versus the Packers, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.
news_items.body: After dealing with muscle tightness in his leg in early August, Waddle got back on the practice field Monday and progressed to team drills one day later. With his health seemingly not in question, he's poised to see his first game action with QB Bo Nix after Denver traded for the wide receiver's services back in March.

news_items.headline: Pineiro converted five PAT's and two field-goal attempts in Thursday night's 41-17 preseason win over the Chargers.
news_items.body: Pineiro made field goals from 48 and 45 yards out and was ultimately flawless on all seven kicks. The seventh-year veteran out of Florida looks set to carry over the momentum from a stellar 2025 season where he made 28 of 29 field-goal attempts and 34 of 38 extra-point tries over 14 regular-season games.

news_items.headline: Allen made his Colts practice debut in Thursday's joint practice with the Falcons, Noah Compton of SI.com reports.
news_items.body: Allen wasn't expected to participate in team drills after signing earlier this week, but he took four reps in 11-on-11 work against Atlanta's defense. "He's been productive every single year he's been in the league. So obviously, we want him to be productive again this year," coach Shane Steichen said Wednesday. "He'll come in - obviously, he's been in this system. He'll pick it up quickly, but he'll play outside. He'll play inside. We'll move all our guys around." Allen is expected to be a main…

news_items.headline: Thornton (undisclosed) didn't practice Monday, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.
news_items.body: Per Levi Damien of USA Today, Thornton has been missing from practice for the past of couple weeks and has yet to play this preseason. When he's able to return,Thornton will look to reestablish his slotting in a Raiders WR corps that also includes Tre Tucker, Jalen Nailor, Jack Bech and Malik Benson.

news_items.headline: Benson (knee) was waived/injured by the Cardinals on Monday, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.
news_items.body: Benson has been in and out of practice throughout training camp due to lingering issues with his surgically repaired left knee that kept him sidelined after Week 4 last season. Arizona made two notable additions to its backfield this offseason in 2026 third overall pick Jeremiyah Love (ankle) and free-agent addition Tyler Allgeier and still retains long-time starter James Conner (foot). Assuming Benson clears waivers Tuesday, he'll revert to injured reserve.

news_items.headline: Malik Nabers (knee) could be ready for Week 1
news_items.body: Giants head coach John Harbaugh said "it's reasonable to assume" that Malik Nabers is trending toward being ready for Week 1. Nabers was able to practice on Monday without the red non-contact jersey. Barring a setback, he is trending towards being ready for the start of the season.

news_items.headline: Trey Benson waived by Cardinals
news_items.body: The Cardinals waived/injured running back Trey Benson. Benson would revert to the Cardinals IR list if he were to clear waivers. He had been at the end of the backfield's depth chart following the offseason additions of Jeremiyah Love and Tyler Allgeier.

news_items.headline: Dylan Horton (Achilles) to miss the 2026 season
news_items.body: Dylan Horton will miss the entirety of the 2026 season due to a torn Achilles. Tests confirmed the severity of Horton's injury on Monday. The fourth-year defensive end played in 16 games for the Texans last season, recording 26 tackles, 0.5 sacks, and one forced fumble.

news_items.headline: Jeanty (ankle) didn't participant in practice Monday, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.
news_items.body: The Raiders experienced a scare when Jeanty went down during Sunday's session and couldn't put any pressure on his right leg as he left the field. Later Sunday evening, Adam Schefter of ESPN reported that Jeanty suffered a sprained ankle that wasn't considered to be a long-term concern, but the second-year running back predictably will require some time on the sideline. Rookie fourth-rounder Mike Washington likely will take on most of the first-team reps during Jeanty's absence.

news_items.headline: The Patriots traded Boutte to the Texans for safety Jaylen Reed and a draft pick Monday, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.
news_items.body: With the additions of A.J. Brown and Romeo Doubs to New England's receiving corps this offseason, a player like Boutte may have felt the roster crunch with cut-down day less than one week away. Now with Houston, Boutte joins a position group that has lost Jayden Higgins for the season due to a torn ACL and also includes the banged-up Jaylin Noel (hamstring) and Tank Dell (knee). As a result, Boutte has a chance to make an impact early on this season.

news_items.headline: Legette (ankle) will remain in a walking boot on his foot until Thursday, Steve Reed of the Associated Press reports.
news_items.body: Legette sustained an ankle injury during Wednesday's joint practice with the Jaguars, and given that he'll be in a walking boot until Thursday, he'll presumably sit out Friday's preseason finale against the Texans. When available, the 2024 first-rounder has an opportunity to claim a portion of the Panthers' WR targets that don't go to Tetairoa McMillan or Jalen Coker, a context that may not yield steady volume as long as both McMillan and Coker are available.

news_items.headline: Pittman (right ankle) was in pads and going through stretching during Monday's practice, Alan Saunders of Steelers Now reports.
news_items.body: After missing practice time since Aug. 8, Pittman at least was back on the field for the early portion of Monday's session. Pittman joins DK Metcalf (undisclosed) among notable Steelers to return to the practice field Monday after missing some time. The development offers a positive step for the Steelers' big offseason acquisition, though it doesn't confirm that he has resumed full practice work. Still, Pittman has time to get back to full-go before the season kicks off Sunday, Sept. 13 versus t…

news_items.body: There was concern about Jeanty's status after he was injured at Sunday's practice and reportedly could not put any weight on his leg, but the initial diagnosis appears more promising than not, with the report noting the Raiders are "breathing a sigh of relief." Both the full extent of Jeanty's injury and a recovery timeline have not yet been revealed, and his status will be updated again when more information is released.

news_items.headline: Jeanty left Sunday's practice with an injury and could not put pressure on his leg while leaving the field, Vincent Bonsignore of the California Post reports.
news_items.body: Jeanty went down after diving for a catch and landing awkwardly, and he could not put any pressure on his right leg while being helped off the field by trainers, according to Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com. Other Raiders players also were seen taking a knee in acknowledgement after the running back left the field. The exact nature and severity of this apparent injury are still unclear, with McFadden suggesting it could be a knee issue, so it will be worth monitoring further updates on the running bac…

news_items.headline: Elliott connected on all three of his extra-point tries and did not attempt any field goals in the Eagles' 24-21 preseason loss to the Patriots on Saturday.
news_items.body: The veteran kicker got some work in ahead of the regular season in Saturday's close loss. Elliott doesn't have any training camp competition despite the fact he's coming off back-to-back seasons with sub-80.0 percent success rates on field goals. Through two preseason games, Elliott has yet to attempt a field goal and has been perfect on his four PATs.

news_items.headline: Mahomes (knee) said during Saturday's preseason game at Tampa Bay that he's "extremely confident" he'll be available Week 1 against the Broncos on Monday, Sept. 14, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.
news_items.body: Mahomes has been cleared for all activity during training camp, and while he wanted to suit up Saturday, coach Andy Reid opted to hold out his franchise quarterback. Mahomes added that he would like to play this coming Friday's exhibition versus the Seahawks, but Reid also will make that decision. In any case, Mahomes appears poised to be active for the season opener following the torn ACL that he suffered Week 15 of the 2025 campaign.

news_items.headline: Dobbins did not play in the Broncos' 33-13 preseason loss to the Packers on Friday.
news_items.body: With Dobbins observing Friday's exhibition contest in street clothes, it was RJ Harvey who drew the start while Jaleel McLaughlin and Cody Schrader led all Broncos running backs in offensive snaps. Dobbins was cleared to return to practice earlier this week after recovering from a soft-tissue injury, but it's unclear whether he'll play in the Broncos' preseason finale against the Vikings this Friday. The 2020 second-rounder figures to be the Broncos' top option out of the backfield this season,…

news_items.headline: Jeudy will not play in the Browns' preseason game against the Bills on Saturday, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.
news_items.body: Jeudy played in the Browns' preseason opener against the Bears this past Saturday, when he caught both of his targets for 18 yards in a 34-10 loss. Jeudy, KC Concepcion and Cedric Tillman (undisclosed) will be sidelined against Buffalo, so Denzel Boston will lead the Browns' wide receiver corps, with Isaiah Bond, Tylan Wallace and Malachi Corley also in line for additional reps.

news_items.headline: McLaurin will play in Saturday's preseason game against the Lions, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
news_items.body: McLaurin will suit up with Stefon Diggs and Jayden Daniels after the trio sat out of Washington's preseason opener against Miami. McLaurin and Diggs are set to lead a Commanders pass-catching corps that also consists of Luke McCaffrey, Treylon Burks, rookie third-rounder Antonio Williams and tight end Chig Okonkwo.

news_items.headline: Legette has his right foot in a boot due to an ankle injury that he sustained during Wednesday's joint practice with the Jaguars, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.
news_items.body: Legette twisted his ankle after he was rolled up on during Wednesday's session, and the injury prevented him from playing in the Carolina's 34-17 preseason win over Jacksonville on Friday. Panthers head coach Dave Canales told reporters after Friday's exhibition game that he wasn't sure whether Legette will practice in the coming week, making it unlikely that the 2024 first-round pick will suit up for the team's preseason finale against the Texans on Friday, Aug. 28. While Legette is sidelined,…

news_items.body: Jordan suffered a hip flexor strain at practice in early August, and he still appears to be less than 100 percent. Fellow running back British Brooks (hand) returned to practice Monday after missing three weeks following hand surgery, and the two players are battling to secure a spot on Houston's initial 53-man roster as reserve options behind Woody Marks and David Montgomery.
